summary: Backend + frontend testing of new CMS list editors (Focus Areas, Initiatives) and admin image-size hints. All 8 pytest cases pass. Playwright confirms admin login, 7 default focus areas + 6 default initiatives rendered after fallback, image hints present for all 6 image slots + QR 500x500 hint, add/reorder of a new focus area persists and renders on homepage (8 cards), and new initiative renders in Programmes section (7 cards). Test data was cleaned up via PUT with empty arrays — site now correctly falls back to built-in 7 focus areas / 6 initiatives on public GET.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 771 lines — consider splitting into DonateEditor, ContactEditor, TextEditor, ListEditor, ImageEditor sub-components for maintainability (not blocking).
Pydantic max_length validation returns 422 for list length > 12 as expected; frontend also enforces via toast — good double-guard.
Backend _assert_safe_email runs for every send_email path; good.
No ObjectId leak — all find_one queries use projection {_id:0}.
React keys use index (`${i}-${title}`) — fine since lists are rebuilt on content refresh.
seed_data_creation: Transient test items (TEST_New Area focus area + TEST_New initiative) were created during Playwright flow and REMOVED afterwards. Final PUT with focus_areas:[] and initiatives:[] confirmed; public GET returns both arrays empty so frontend falls back to the 7 default focus areas and 6 default initiatives.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cms_lists.py covers focus_areas/initiatives CRUD + max_length(12) + auth guard + donate regression. Run via: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Admin dashboard at /admin uses httpOnly cookies (credentials: 'include'). FocusAreas uses a 5-length SPAN_PATTERN modulo so any item count tiles correctly; verified 8-card layout did not break visually.
